posts.text: California, get out and vote! If I lived in LA, a fantastic city filled with lots of great and frustrated people, I would vote @spencerpratt for LA mayor and @SteveHiltonx for governor. Both would be fantastic choices. Go vote!

West Virginia fans and players all sing “Country Roads,” in unison after their walk off extra innings regional win. Totally awesome.

Video
This entire West Virginia stadium singing “Country Roads,” together is absolutely badass.
This Kentucky-West Virginia series has been bonkers. Honestly, I can’t stop flipping around from softball to baseball elimination games for the past several days. Just phenomenal sports TV.

If they didn’t put 60 Minutes on immediately after NFL games, how many people would watch? Almost none. Could any 60 Minutes employees make a living off the show independently in media? I don’t think so. It’s astounding to me how entitled & cocky these “journalists” are.

Today the ladies on the View called Maine Democrat senate candidate Graham Platner a racist liar. Democrats have ordered the code red on Platner. Feels like more awful revelations are coming. It’s a Swalwell-like implosion.

Video

I get it, mom’s happy, maybe actually show the kid who hit the winning homerun running the bases? I feel like lots of sports producers over do it now with traction shots. Keep the cameras on the field when the play is going on.

Oklahoma ends Georgia Tech’s season on this walk off homer. Sports production note: is it just me or do we get way too many crowd and reaction shots and not enough of the actual athletes now? Let us see him run the bases! Show the reactions later.

Video

The number one and number two seeds, UCLA and Georgia Tech, both lost in the regionals at home. College baseball still has upsets, college basketball no longer does, May Madness has replaced March Madness. (I know today is technically June 1, dorks).

Mike Vrabel gets AJ Brown back. The Titans have been a disaster since the AJ trade. Love the move Patriots are now loaded at wide receiver for Drake Maye. (I do wish Dianna Russini had come back on Twitter to break the news, would have been an all timer.)
ESPN has sold off nearly half of the college football playoff games in this upcoming year. Budget issues? Also, playing the title game on January 25th is absolutely insane. Way too late.

The Browns have traded Myles Garrett to the Rams for Jared Verse and a first round pick. The Rams are the current favorite to win the Super Bowl this year at +650 on @HardRockBet. Ravens and Bills are tied for second at 10-1.

Fired MSNBC host Joy Reid says she has always been a Giants fan, but now can’t root for the team since Jaxson Dart introduced President Trump. 0% chance she could answer basic questions on Giants fandom.
